release.title: Modularization & Image Storage Pipeline
changes: Modularized project code structures into core modules and widgets providers.
Implemented encrypted local image storage pipeline for memories.
Upgraded local Room database schema migrations to version 14.

release.title: Aesthetic Themes & Core Bitacora
changes: Launched core dynamic lived time tracking system (MVVM + Jetpack Compose).
Integrated 13 nostalgic color schemes (Clannad, Violet Evergarden, Spiritfarer, etc.).
Added editable custom user palettes (CUSTOM_1, CUSTOM_2, CUSTOM_3).

beta.title: Time Capsules & Password-Protected Backups
changes: Introduced Time Capsules to lock diary entries until a specific future date.
Added secure password protection option for local backup exports (.lifelogs).
Upgraded database schema migrations to version 12.

alpha.title: Native Security Layer & Memory Zero-out
changes: Integrated Native C/C++ security audit layers for cryptographic key hardening.
Implemented background memory zero-out routine to protect local diagnostics.
Google Play Store closed alpha testing uploaded for hardware logic verification.
